description: Synthetic two-category survey extract with replicate weights for a Fay BRR demonstration; weights are deliberately simple and are not a real survey design.

fields.satisfied: Binary top-box response: 1 satisfied, 0 not satisfied
fields.final_weight: Final analysis weight for the weighted point estimate
fields.replicate_1 through replicate_4: Replicate weights; compute each weighted share, then Fay BRR standard error with k=0.5
